name: A beached Tanka boat adapted as a dwelling
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a boatwoman and child by a makeshift cabin fashioned from the bamboo and rattan superstructure of a beached Tanka boat; with studies of a figure hammering, and a goat.
